## My request:
시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Requester meaning is an independent, complex, random winter-fashion generation test using the supplied portrait, with a photographic result that can be inspected. Winter fashion is the contextual antecedent to the request. I chose a woman finishing the small task of changing a cinema poster after snowfall; that fiction, the case, all garment particulars and the viewpoint are agent-owned. An old curled poster and tube explain the preceding task, gloved contact makes its completion visible, and the lit entrance offers an immediate next destination. The intended experience is quiet accomplishment and an inviting absorbed presence within warm wool and polished leather, framed by cold snow. Sensual 1 is a subtle supporting quality, fetish 0 adds no treatment, creativity 1 keeps restrained development close to winter fashion, and surreal 0 keeps ordinary physics. Reference use guides visible face and hair appearance only; it provides no biography, personality or guarantee of exact identity. A standing three-quarter finish is preferred to a static glamorous pose or a crouched repair because it keeps the event and garment junctions legible.
subject: A woman guided by the supplied portrait, in a layered winter outfit
setting: A small neighborhood cinema threshold after snowfall at blue hour
event: She finishes closing the waist-high poster-case latch after replacing the poster
visual_priorities: The two gloved hands finish one understandable task: one presses the brass latch and the other steadies the low display frame, with the discarded poster and tube accounting for the preceding action.
The open coat reveals a continuous central knit-and-skirt layer, while glove, sweater cuff and coat sleeve form separate successive wrist edges.
Opaque rib-knit tights, gray wool sock bands and chestnut boot rims form connected but visibly distinct layers on both legs.
The scarf loops below the visible turtleneck collar and ends in two separated fringed tails outside the coat fronts.
An attentive face and dark bob catch warm doorway light against a snowy blue threshold, with all relevant garment junctions retained in the full-body view.
baseline_prompt_en: A winter fashion photograph shows a woman guided by the attached portrait, wearing a layered winter outfit at a small neighborhood cinema just after a snowfall. Use the attached portrait as a guide to visible face and hair appearance: soft oval facial proportions, brown eyes, a chin-length straight dark bob and lightly separated wispy bangs. She has just replaced the poster in a low glass display case beside the entrance; a discarded curled paper sheet and an empty poster tube lie together on the stone step. The new poster is a simple red and cream graphic behind glass. Her right gloved hand presses the small brass latch closed at waist height while her left gloved hand steadies the case's lower frame. The fingers curl around the frame edge and the other wrist aligns naturally with the latch, so the purpose and the finishing moment are clear. She stands comfortably beside the case with both feet on the broad dry center of the step, her right foot slightly forward and her shoulders turned a little toward the display. Her arms stay in front of her torso with bent elbows, and the two forearms and hands remain separately traceable. Her attentive gaze follows the latch, lips softly parted and shoulders relaxed; warm entrance light grazes her cheek and lends a quiet inviting quality to the absorbed expression. Her stone-gray wool coat is unfastened, its long front panels falling to either side of a charcoal above-knee pleated tweed skirt. A fitted cream rib-knit turtleneck fills the open upper coat; its collar rises above the scarf at the chin. An ivory knitted scarf loops around her lower neck, and two separate fringed ends hang down outside the coat fronts, leaving the central sweater and skirt opening readable. Burgundy leather full-finger gloves cover both hands. Their wrist cuffs extend beneath the cream sweater cuffs, which emerge from the gray coat sleeves as three distinct successive edges. Dark opaque rib-knit tights cover both legs continuously from the skirt hem down to gray wool sock cuffs. Each sock cuff makes a short visible knitted band above the rim of a chestnut leather knee-high boot and lies over the tights. Both boots have fitted shafts ending just below the knees, almond toes, low block heels and distinct outsoles. The front opening of the coat leaves the tights, sock bands and boot rims visible together. Frame her from the top of the hair to the boot soles in a vertical, three-quarter frontal photograph, with the low case beside her rather than across her body. A normal lens from chest height keeps the face, wrists and leg junctions legible at one natural scale. Warm light from the cinema doorway meets cool blue snow along the edge of the step; the softly focused interior beyond the glass suggests where she will go next. Preserve visible knit ribs, wool fuzz, leather creases and grounded shadows, with an inhabited observational fashion mood.
